definitions.explanation: An official search or inquiry, especially by police to solve crimes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{捜査|そうさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}けている→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧。
examples.english: The police are continuing the investigation of the case.

examples.japanese: {捜査|そうさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As a result of the investigation, a suspect was arrested.

examples.japanese: {捜査|そうさ}⟦{当局|とうきょく}→当局：12540_toukyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: The investigative authorities are gathering evidence.

notes:
{捜査|そうさ} refers specifically to criminal investigations conducted by law enforcement. It implies official, systematic inquiry to solve crimes.

COMPOUNDS:
{捜|そう} (search) + {査|さ} (investigate, inspect).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {捜査|そうさ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to investigate)
- {捜査|そうさ}⟦{当局|とうきょく}→当局：12540_toukyoku⟧ (investigative authorities)
- {捜査|そうさ}⟦{本部|ほんぶ}→本部：00112_honbu⟧ (investigation headquarters)
- {捜査|そうさ}{員|いん} (investigator)
- {捜査|そうさ}{線上|せんじょう} (under investigation)
- {捜査|そうさ}に⟦{乗|の}り{出|だ}す→乗り出す：05760_noridasu⟧ (to launch an investigation)

WATCH OUT:
⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧ (operation, manipulation of machines/data) is pronounced identically. Very common source of confusion — always check the kanji.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (investigation, survey — broader, not limited to criminal cases)
- {取|と}り{調|しら}べ (interrogation, questioning of a suspect)
